messages:
deploy-bot: :calendar: Heads-up: Scheduled maintenance window for runtime upgrade
- When: Mon 2026-03-23 02:00-03:30 UTC
- Scope: Hosted inference (routes: text-gen-prod, chat-prod)
- Plan: canary start 02:00 (10% traffic), evaluate 20m, gradual rollout 02:20, rollback window until 02:50
- Impact: brief 503s possible during variant switch; streaming sessions may reconnect
Details and runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/runtime-upgrade-2026-03-23

rajesh: Adding ops checklist / playbook so support + comms know what to push. Key things:
- Canary metric gates: 95th-latency < 250ms and error-rate delta < 0.5%
- Auto-fallback: if gate fails, deploy-bot will hold and route to fallback model (v1.9.8-pin)
- Manual rollback command (ops):
```bash
redwoodctl deploy rollback --service runtime --to v1.9.8 --reason "runtime perf/regression"
```
- Pinning command for VIP customers we want to exclude from rollout: 
```bash
redwoodctl customer pin-model --customer-id=ACME_CORP --model=v1.9.8
```

anita: Support needs two short comms: a public statuspage blurb and a customer email template for Dedicated accounts. We'll send email 12h before and a reminder 1h before. Can someone draft? :eyes:

lucy: Drafts below — feel free to tweak. Keeping public statuspage short. Dedicated customer email has placeholders.

Public statuspage snippet (short):
```
Scheduled maintenance: We will perform a runtime upgrade on Mon 2026-03-23 02:00-03:30 UTC. Some hosted inference requests may see temporary interruptions; work will be completed within the maintenance window. We will post updates here.```

Dedicated customer email (longer):
```
Subject: Upcoming maintenance: runtime upgrade — Mon 2026-03-23 02:00 UTC (UTC)

Hi {{customer_name}},

We will be performing a scheduled runtime upgrade to improve inference latency and reliability on Mon 2026-03-23 between 02:00 and 03:30 UTC. During the window some hosted inference traffic may experience short interruptions or reconnects. If you require zero-surface changes, reply and we can pin your tenant to the current model variant for the window.

Planned actions:
- Canary (10% traffic) at 02:00, full rollout by 02:20
- Rollback option until 02:50 if we observe regressions

If you have any concerns or need us to pin your traffic, please reply to this email or open a support ticket.

Thanks,\nRedwood Support & Operations
```

mike: Ops note — when you pin a customer, add a ticket tag `pin-exempt-2026-03-23` so SRE and billing know. Also prepare a short internal slack status snippet we can paste to status page updates during the window.

olivia: Product sign-off: thumbs up on the rollback gates. One request — add a small performance smoke test in the canary for long-context streams (>= 2k tokens). If that fails, auto-hold and notify product + eng-oncall.

rajesh: Will add smoke test to canary job and update runbook. Final checklist:
- [x] statuspage blurb drafted
- [x] customer email drafted
- [x] rollback command validated in staging
- [ ] pinning playbook + ticket automation (in progress)

anita: Support will schedule the 12h and 1h emails and hold on DMs for any Dedicated accounts that ask to be pinned. Thanks all :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-03-22 14:00 UTC — pre-notice to customers (~12h). Canary job will post results to this thread at 02:25 UTC. :rocket:
